feeds.title: I Love NY Blog
feeds.description: Explore all the state of New York has to offer including fun things to do, year-round events and festivals, world-class hotels and award-winning restaurants. Follow these blog posts from I Love NY that highlight the latest and greatest of what's going on in New York State including attractions and events.

feeds.title: Loving New York
feeds.description: We're Sabrina and Selwyn from Loving New York. Check out our ultimate guide to one of the best cities in the world. Find out why you need to visit and get excited about all of the amazing things you can do during your stay. We always give you the inside scoop & honest reviews!

feeds.title: NYC Insider Guide
feeds.description: Melissa Trachtenberg, a fourth-generation New Yorker, started this website to help you plan your New York visit. Here, you'll find articles about New York City tourist & travel guides, hotel deals, things to do, events, museums, attractions, shows, tours, maps, and shopping, and the best of NYC.

feeds.title: Architecture Art Designs
feeds.description: Covers Events, Festivals, Family Friendly Places, Travel Itineraries, Kid-Free Activities, Budget Travel to visit New York. Go City offers sightseeing passes that cover different attractions in domestic & international travel destinations.

feeds.title: Travel New York Now Blog
feeds.description: A website all about traveling New York like a local! Kelly is a sassy New Yorker who is passionate about her hometown and wants to show you how to travel to New York like a pro.For your next trip, use these New York travel tips and New York travel guides!

feeds.title: Uncovering New York Blog
feeds.description: Looking for the best things to do in New York? Come along with Jim Cheney as he uncovers the hidden gems throughout the state. Whether you love hiking to waterfalls, visiting fascinating museums, or drinking at local breweries, you've come to the right place.

feeds.title: Dominican Abroad Blog
feeds.description: A travel blog by a multicultural Latina travel blogger from NYC; sharing insights from around the world on travel, culture, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Tracy Kaler » New York Blog
feeds.description: A blog offering tips on living in, moving to, and visiting New York. Authored by Tracy Kaler, a New York based lifestyle and travel writer who has a passion for food, wine, and exploring other cultures.

feeds.title: Lyssy in the City
feeds.description: NYC Based Food and Travel Blog. Lyssy is a Michigan native living in NYC with a passion for food, travel, yoga, puppies, and fitness. This blog documents her adventures in NYC and lots of places she visits, the food she eats, workouts she completes, and all of life's moments in between.

feeds.title: ExperienceFirst Blog » New York
feeds.description: Here, you can find all the New York travel tips, guides, travel trends, and many more! ExperienceFirst's award-winning tours create memorable experiences and save time for our guests with optimized itineraries, skip-the-line tickets, and expert local guides.

feeds.title: Bobo and ChiChi » New York
feeds.description: Find all the New York travel guides, travel tips, and itineraries to help you plan your next trip! Bobo and ChiChi provide you with information and active travel guides with the perfect combination of iconic locations and authentic experiences.

feeds.title: New York City Travel Tips
feeds.description: New York City Travel Tips: your guide for all things in New York including restaurants, attractions, famous places, and many more! Our guides are everything you need to know to make your trip easier, with great tips and advice before and during your stay in New York.

feeds.title: Mad Hatters NYC Blog
feeds.description: A NYC-based travel, lifestyle and food website

feeds.title: Sarah Funky
feeds.description: Experience More

feeds.title: Travel Lovers
feeds.description: A blog for all NYC lovers! Plan your trip, discover New York, its activities, its secrets, and all its must-see attractions!

feeds.title: The Adventuring Millennial » New York
feeds.description: Discover New York travel tips, itinerary guides, travel adventures, and must-eat food guides. The Adventuring Millennial is a travel blog by Stephanie, a 20-something millennial with a serious case of wanderlust, who blogs about her travel experiences in the hopes of inspiring you to travel more.

feeds.title: Exploring Upstate Blog
feeds.description: If you're looking for things to do and stories to read about Upstate New York, then check out the Exploring Upstate blog with all our posts from the Empire State. This blog follows creator Chis Clemens from his home in Rochester to discover Upstate New York and its culture, history, people, cities and towns, food, and all the rest.

feeds.title: The Savvy Backpacker » New York City
feeds.description: We've been called NYC home for a few years and now we're sharing some of our favorite things about this amazing city. The Savvy Backpacker is the ultimate guide for budget backpackers who want honest, in-depth, and independent travel advice for their next trip to Europe.

feeds.title: Shiloh in the City
feeds.description: I'm Shiloh Frederick, and Shiloh in the City is a resource for both NYC locals and visitors who want to get to know New York beyond their day-to-day experiences and the superficial level of most guidebooks. Using history, humor, and my own experiences, I encourage people to explore NYC, whether they plan to be here for three days or three decades.

feeds.title: Jessica Wang » Travel
feeds.description: A top New York City based fashion blogger

feeds.title: NewYork.co.uk
feeds.description: Welcome to New York City! My name is Eric and I love New York so much that I created my site to give you loads of up-to-date information about it. On this site you'll find ways to book your hotel, tickets for sports games and Broadway shows, or any of the famous attractions. The daily updated calendar will show you what's going on during your stay. You'll also find where to find the best rooftop bars and playgrounds and, my personal favourite, the best burgers and pizza!

feeds.title: Sea The City Blog
feeds.description: Looking for something to do in NYC? Sea the City not only offers unique ways to see the city, but we also offer tips, advice, and best-of lists for other tourist activities in NYC. Get the latest from NYC experts and residents on what to do while in NYC. Sea The City is NYC's jet ski tour operator that offers hot tub boat tours in NYC & Fort Lauderdale!
